content: G20 (inch) / G21 (mm) select unit interpretation for ALL subsequent distance values (X/Y/Z, feed rate F, arc radius R) -- they do not convert an existing program's values, they just change how numbers are read. If a file omits G20/G21, the machine/parser falls back to a default unit which may not match the file's actual authoring unit, causing a silent 25.4x scale error. Best practice: require and validate an explicit unit declaration at the top of the file (or expose a unit selector in the UI) rather than assuming mm; treat a missing unit directive as a hard warning, not a silent default.
